title: Sailor's Treasure
description: Zhang Shun is not doing well financially, he's looking for ways to earn more Mora...

dialogs.text: Hmm, what to do, what to do...
What's wrong?
I used to be a sailor with The Crux, until I suffered an unlucky injury...
After I left the fleet I needed money, so I pawned a few Treasure Maps. I gave them to local businessman Bolai.
The agreement was that I would get a share of any treasure found. But I haven't heard a word from him since, and I suspect he hasn't even tried to look for the treasure.
I can't keep waiting around like this. Would you be willing to search for the treasure for me?
Okay.
Thank you.

Start by paying a visit to <color=#00E1FFFF>Bolai</color> to fetch the <color=#00E1FFFF>Treasure Maps</color>. Then, find the <color=#00E1FFFF>treasure</color> and <color=#00E1FFFF>take it to him</color>.
I spoke to him about it already. He will hold onto my share for me.
What made you leave the fleet?
I realized that my past injury could flare up at any point and start causing real trouble. I couldn't let something like that put the rest of the crew at risk, so I chose to leave.
I started selling a few odds and ends that I'd picked up over the years to earn a living. But business wasn't great and I soon ran out of things to sell anyway.
I used to own a few Treasure Maps. They were loot I picked up back in the day with the crew.
In my condition though, it's enough of a struggle just to walk down the street... I can't exactly go shooting off around the world on a treasure hunt, can I?
So I pawned them, gave them to Bolai for a bit of cash.
But it seems like he can't go and look for the treasure in person either. He is just a businessman, after all... So that's why I need your help.
How much treasure are we talking?
Oh, there won't be a huge amount. These were just low-profile treasure maps split among the crew members along with the rest of the loot.
The experienced crew of the fleet can always tell when there's a serious amount of treasure involved, and they'll track it down and bring it back to the ship.
Any treasure we find will be on the smaller scale, but it will still be worth something. Certainly enough to split three ways... So good luck out there!
If it wasn't for my injury... I could be out there chasing down even bigger treasure hoards with the captain and my old crew mates...
*sigh* What I would give to be back on board that ship just one more time...
Hello there, my friend! What can I get you?
Treasure Maps.
Treasure Maps? Oh, you must mean Zhang Shun's maps.
So, you're really going to look for this treasure, eh? I must say, I only ever saw them as a bit of fun.
You, though, I can tell with one look that you're the real adventurer type. The sort whose eyes light up as soon as someone mentions the word "treasure."
I don't have much use for these Treasure Maps at the end of the day, so you might as well have them.
That said, if you do find any treasure, let's split it evenly.
After all, I have been looking after these maps for a while. It's only fair to contribute something in the way of storage fees...
Are you sure? I would have thought it'd be a useful nugget of information...

dialogs.text: You're back! Found the treasure?
Yes.
Nice one! I said you looked like a real adventurer, didn't I? Well, now you've proven it.
Right, let's see what we have in this box... Hmph. What a pile of junk...
Well, can't blame you for trying! Here's your share, I'll hold on to Zhang Shun's share until he comes to collect it.
*sigh* Still didn't find it... That guy is taking me for a ride, I swear...
You're back! Found the treasure?
Yes.
Nice one! I said you looked like a real adventurer, didn't I? Well, now you've proven it.
Right, let's see what we have in this box... What's this? Map fragments?
Huh, so he was right. Those batty old Treasure Maps really do have clues to where the treasure lies...
Oh? You're still here? Here, take your share... and hurry along now, you must have other things to do. I'll hold Zhang Shun's share till he comes to collect it.
Yes please.
Alright... There you go.
Have a good one. And don't forget to bring the treasure back here when you find it — we split it three ways, as agreed.
No need.
Alright then, it's your funeral...
Have a good one. And don't forget to bring the treasure back here when you find it — we split it three ways, as agreed.
I almost forgot, do you know how to read these Treasure Maps?
Frankly, I couldn't make head or tail of them when I first got them, so I had several people take a look.
They figured out more or less where the treasure is. But they said if I went to look for the treasure, I should pay them an extra fee... That's why I never bothered to go.
If it saves you the bother, I can mark the location for you, no problem. Just say the word.
But, y'know, I'd have to make you pay a contribution... Let's call it <color=#00E1FFFF>100 Mora</color>?
What do you say? Shall I <color=#00E1FFFF>mark the location</color> on the Treasure Maps for you?
